Package com.splendor.model

Enum Class MoveType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<MoveType>
com.splendor.model.MoveType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<MoveType>, Constable
public enum MoveType extends Enum<MoveType>
Enumeration of all possible move types a player can execute during their turn. Each move type represents a distinct action in the Splendor game, with its own validation rules, game mechanics, and effects on the game state. The move types are used by the controller layer to interpret player input and by the validator layer to check move legality.

The available move types are:

  • TAKE_THREE_DIFFERENT - Take one token each of three different gem colors
  • TAKE_TWO_SAME - Take two tokens of the same gem color (requires ≥4 available)
  • RESERVE_CARD - Reserve a card (face-up or from deck) and receive a gold token
  • BUY_CARD - Purchase a card using tokens and/or discounts
  • DISCARD_TOKENS - Return excess tokens when exceeding the maximum limit
  • EXIT_GAME - Terminate the game session (console mode only)

Move validation is performed by MoveValidator, which checks preconditions specific to each move type.
